sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these leaves has a smooth texture?
What color do we mostly use to paint an ocean in an aqua world drawing?
What is the best way to describe 'still life' drawing?
options: A) Drawing moving cars on a road
B) Drawing objects placed on a table
C) Drawing a flying bird in the sky
questions.answer: B) Drawing objects placed on a table

questions.question_text: How can you best show a person running in a drawing?
options: A) Draw them sleeping in bed
B) Draw them sitting on a chair
C) Draw their legs bent and arms swinging
D) Draw them standing completely straight
questions.answer: C) Draw their legs bent and arms swinging

questions.question_text: What material can you use to make a rough, bumpy texture on your paper?
When you look at a distant mountain in a landscape, how does it appear?
options: A) Bigger than a tree nearby
B) Smaller and lighter in color
C) Exactly the same as a nearby rock
questions.answer: B) Smaller and lighter in color

questions.question_text: Which of the following animals belongs in an Aqua World drawing?
If you are drawing a flying car, what are you mostly using?
Which of these is a musical instrument used in performing arts?
What body part is mainly used to make footwork sounds in a dance?
How would you arrange an apple, a vase, and a book for a still life drawing? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would place the tall vase at the back, the open book next to it, and put the small red apple in the front so everything is visible.

questions.question_text: Name two things in nature that feel rough and two things that feel smooth. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Tree bark and dry rocks feel very rough to touch. Flower petals and wet river stones feel very smooth and soft when you slide your fingers over them.

questions.question_text: Describe how the arms and legs look when drawing a person jumping. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: When drawing a jumping person, both legs are bent and lifted off the ground. The arms are thrown up high in the air to show upward movement.

questions.question_text: What specific items would you draw to create a beautiful underwater scene? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would draw green seaweeds moving in the water, a large brown treasure chest, colorful fishes, and a big grey shark swimming near some orange corals.

questions.question_text: Name three simple items you can use from your home to create an art craft project. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I can use empty cardboard boxes, colorful old magazine pages, and loose buttons to create a beautiful and unique craft project for my classroom display.

questions.question_text: Imagine you found a magical tree in a forest. Describe what its leaves and fruits look like. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The magical tree has shiny silver leaves that chime like tiny bells when the wind blows. Its fruits are shaped like glowing blue stars that light up the forest at night. The trunk is painted in bright rainbow colors that constantly shift and change in the sunlight.

questions.question_text: Look out your imaginary window at a busy city street. Describe three things you can see happening. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: From my window, I see a bright yellow bus carrying excited children to school. A man in a blue cap is selling fresh red apples from a wooden cart. Below, a small fluffy dog is happily chasing a floating green balloon down the busy sidewalk.

questions.question_text: How would you express the feeling of anger and the feeling of joy using only colors and lines on a paper? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To express anger, I would use dark red and black colors with sharp, zig-zag lines and heavy, forceful brushstrokes that look like lightning. To express joy, I would use bright yellow, orange, and pink colors with soft, flowing circles and curvy shapes that feel light and bouncy like a sunny day.

questions.question_text: Create a simple sequence of three dance steps to show a flower growing from the ground to the sun. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, I would curl up tightly into a small ball on the floor like a tiny seed. Second, I would slowly lift my head and stretch my arms upward, rising to my knees to show the stem growing. Finally, I would stand up tall on my toes and spread my hands wide to bloom.
